## Row {height=45%}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
months = d3.range(24).map(i => new Date(2023, i, 1))
series = ["Bus", "Light rail", "Commuter rail", "Bike share", "Vanpool"]
base = [1820, 610, 215, 38, 24]
rows = series.flatMap((s, k) => months.map((m, i) => ({
  month: m, mode: s,
  value: Math.round(base[k] * (1 + 0.012 * i) * (1 + 0.05 * Math.sin((i % 12 - 2) / 12 * 2 * Math.PI)))
})))
chart = n => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(`--wfrc-chart-${n}`).trim()
```

### Column {width=65%}

::: {.card title="Average weekday boardings by mode"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  width: 760, height: 320, marginRight: 90,
  y: {grid: true, label: "Boardings (thousands)"},
  color: {domain: series, range: [1,2,3,4,5].map(chart), legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(rows, {x: "month", y: "value", stroke: "mode", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.text(rows.filter(d => +d.month === +months[23]), {x: "month", y: "value", text: "mode", dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fill: "currentColor"})
  ]
})
```
:::

### Column {width=35%}

::: {.card title="Share of boardings by county"}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 80, height: 320,
  x: {label: "%", grid: true}, y: {label: null},
  marks: [Plot.barX([
    {c: "Salt Lake", v: 58.4}, {c: "Utah", v: 17.2}, {c: "Davis", v: 9.1},
    {c: "Weber", v: 6.3}, {c: "Tooele", v: 1.1}, {c: "Box Elder", v: 0.6}
  ], {x: "v", y: "c", sort: {y: "-x"}, fill: chart(1), rx: 4})]
})
```
:::
